bulletin.text: Morning of 18 September 2026. Fires detected on 17 September 2026 put 124 fires in Priority 1 in West Kalimantan. The ten fires at the top of the list carry 51% of the modelled smoke over residents. Fire 1, near Ketapang, carries 10.2% of it; 2,351,572 residents live within 40 km of its smoke path, and its smoke is heading NW, already over Ketapang as the window opens. Fire 2, near Ketapang, carries 7.0% of it; 2,494,286 residents live within 40 km of its smoke path, and its smoke is heading NW, already over Ketapang as the window opens. Fire 3, near Ketapang, carries 6.8% of it; 1,751,035 residents live within 40 km of its smoke path, and its smoke is heading NW, already over Ketapang as the window opens. New in the top ten today: fires near Ketapang. This is a ranking index, not a forecast of smoke concentration. People outside Indonesia are not counted. The task force decides.
